nodes.name: Fetch Top Predictions
nodes.notes: Fetches current predictions from GTAVI.AI. If /api/predictions-feed doesn't exist, replace with a Code node that hard-codes the week's featured prediction IDs.

values.content: You are the GTAVI.AI content strategist. Write short, punchy social posts about GTA VI economy predictions. Tone: analytical but hype. No emojis unless they serve the point. No hashtag spam — max 2 hashtags. Always include the poll URL.

parameters.name: post
parameters.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ profile_ids: ['REPLACE_PROFILE_ID_X'], text: $json.copy.x, media_urls: [$json.ogImageUrl], scheduled_at: new Date(Date.now() + 3600000).toISOString() }) }}

nodes.name: Publer — Schedule X Post
nodes.notes: Replace REPLACE_PUBLER_TOKEN with your Publer API token. Replace REPLACE_PROFILE_ID_X with your X profile ID from Publer dashboard.

parameters.name: post
parameters.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ profile_ids: ['REPLACE_PROFILE_ID_IG'], text: $json.copy.x, media_urls: [$json.ogImageUrl], scheduled_at: new Date(Date.now() + 5400000).toISOString() }) }}

nodes.name: Publer — Schedule Instagram Post
nodes.notes: Replace REPLACE_PROFILE_ID_IG with your Instagram profile ID from Publer dashboard.

parameters.name: post
parameters.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ profile_ids: ['REPLACE_PROFILE_ID_REDDIT'], text: $json.copy.reddit.body, title: $json.copy.reddit.title, url: $json.pollUrl, scheduled_at: new Date(Date.now() + 7200000).toISOString() }) }}

nodes.name: Publer — Schedule Reddit Post
nodes.notes: Replace REPLACE_PROFILE_ID_REDDIT with your Reddit profile ID from Publer dashboard.

parameters.name: post
parameters.value:
={{ JSON.stringify({ subject: `GTA VI Poll: ${$('Select Featured Poll').first().json.question}`, content: `

${$json.copy.reddit.title}

${$json.copy.reddit.body}

Vote now: ${$json.pollUrl}

See all predictions →

`, status: 'draft', audience: 'free' }) }}

nodes.name: Beehiiv — Create Newsletter Draft
nodes.notes: Creates as 'draft' — review in Beehiiv before sending. Change status to 'confirmed' to auto-send. Replace REPLACE_BEEHIIV_PUBLICATION_ID and REPLACE_BEEHIIV_API_KEY.

parameters.name: embeds
parameters.value: ={{ JSON.stringify([{ title: $json.question, url: $json.pollUrl, color: 16096777, image: { url: $json.ogImageUrl }, fields: $json.options.map((opt, i) => ({ name: `Option ${i+1}`, value: opt, inline: true })), footer: { text: `${$json.confidence}% confidence · ${$json.tier} · GTAVI.AI` } }]) }}

nodes.name: Discord — Post Digest
nodes.notes: Replace REPLACE_DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL with your Discord webhook URL from Settings → Integrations → Webhooks.

meta.description: Weekly GTAVI.AI social media pipeline. Fetches featured poll, generates copy via Claude, schedules posts via Publer to X/Instagram/Reddit, creates Beehiiv newsletter draft, posts Discord digest. Runs Monday 08:00 UTC.

placeholders.REPLACE_WITH_ANTHROPIC_CREDENTIAL_ID: Create in n8n: Credentials → New → Anthropic
placeholders.REPLACE_PUBLER_TOKEN: Publer Dashboard → Settings → API → Copy token
placeholders.REPLACE_PROFILE_ID_X: Publer Dashboard → Profiles → X → Copy profile ID
placeholders.REPLACE_PROFILE_ID_IG: Publer Dashboard → Profiles → Instagram → Copy profile ID
placeholders.REPLACE_PROFILE_ID_REDDIT: Publer Dashboard → Profiles → Reddit → Copy profile ID
placeholders.REPLACE_BEEHIIV_API_KEY: Beehiiv Dashboard → Settings → API Keys → Generate
placeholders.REPLACE_DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL: Discord → Server Settings → Integrations → Webhooks → Copy URL
